requirements.title: Keywords use name syntax
requirements.definition: The syntax nonterminal keyword is a name. The rule supplies the name-shaped keyword token used by argument lists, type parameter specifications, component specifications and other enclosing lists; it does not own placement, duplication, optionality or the existence of a matching item.

pending.actual-argument-keyword-name: PENDING positive control calls subroutine s(dummy=37) through dummy= and copies the dummy to a sentinel result so keyword identity is observable. Invalid name spelling belongs to R603 or the enclosing list syntax, not this facet.
pending.type-parameter-keyword-name: PENDING positive control declares character(len=3) c initialized from abc and checks LEN(c)==3; malformed LEN spelling remains R603 or enclosing type-spec syntax evidence.
pending.component-keyword-name: PENDING positive control constructs type t with integer component value by t(value=19) and checks the component; unknown or malformed component names remain owned by constructor constraints and R603.
pending.name-syntax-delegation: PENDING source-use inventory maps future keyword occurrences to R516 only for the keyword-as-name grammar link; placement, order and duplication rules stay with the enclosing list catalogues.

requirements.oracle: Positive controls use exact integer and character-length observations in contexts that already require the enclosing list form to be otherwise conforming.
requirements.oracle_limitation: Every malformed keyword spelling also violates name syntax under R603, and many keyword mistakes violate enclosing list rules. No diagnostic facet is attributed solely to R516 without a future source-use review that isolates the grammar link.
requirements.dependencies: 6.2.2/R603 supplies name spelling; 7.5.10 owns structure-constructor component keywords; 7.4.4 and type-parameter rules own type-param-spec contexts; 15.5.2 owns actual argument association and dummy argument names.

accounting.rationale: Defines non-statement keywords as list item identifiers introduced by keyword=. Actual list placement, optionality and reordering rules remain with each enclosing syntax.
Defines argument, type parameter and component keyword roles. Procedure interfaces, type parameter specifications and structure constructors remain with Clauses 7 and 15.
The note describes readability, reordering and omitted optional items; notes are not normative requirements.

review_rationale: Source registration for 5.4.7-5.4.11 and 5.5-5.5.7 of the Clause 5 overview (batch250). Every unit hash-verified by an independent reviewer across two rounds; restated rules are cross-referenced to their owning catalogues, R516 had no existing tests, and processor-dependent text is latitude. Source accounting only.
